places.name: Alhambra
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this historic palace and fortress complex showcases Islamic architecture and stunning gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during special events.

places.place_tip: Book tickets well in advance to secure entry.
places.address: Calle Real de la Alhambra, s/n, 18009 Granada, Spain

places.name: Generalife Gardens
places.ai_summary: The summer palace and gardens of the Nasrid rulers, offering tranquility and breathtaking views of Granada.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in spring for blooming flowers.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking.
places.address: Calle Real de la Alhambra, s/n, 18009 Granada, Spain

places.name: Albaicín Quarter
places.ai_summary: A historic Arab quarter with narrow winding streets, offering a glimpse into Granada's Moorish past.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot. Be cautious of uneven surfaces.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the views from the Mirador de San Nicolás.
places.address: Albaicín, 18010 Granada, Spain

places.name: Mirador de San Nicolás
places.ai_summary: A viewpoint offering one of the best panoramic views of the Alhambra and the Sierra Nevada mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to secure a good spot, especially at sunset.
places.address: Calle Mirador de San Nicolás, 18010 Granada, Spain

places.name: Granada Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A magnificent example of Spanish Renaissance architecture, this cathedral is located in the heart of Granada.
places.cost: Free entry, fees for guided tours

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Consider joining a guided tour to learn about the cathedral's history.
places.address: Catedral de Granada, Plaza de la Iglesia, 18001 Granada, Spain

places.name: Royal Chapel of Granada
places.ai_summary: The burial place of Catholic Monarchs Ferdinand and Isabella, this chapel is a masterpiece of Gothic architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit the adjoining Granada Cathedral for a complete historical experience.
places.address: Calle Oficios, 29, 18001 Granada, Spain

places.name: Sacromonte Caves
places.ai_summary: Famous for their whitewashed cave houses, these caves are a unique part of Granada's cultural heritage.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are recommended to explore the caves.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a flamenco show in the evening.
places.address: Camino del Sacromonte, 18010 Granada, Spain

places.name: Carrera del Darro
places.ai_summary: A picturesque street along the Darro River, known for its charming views and historic significance.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot. Be cautious of slippery paths.

places.place_tip: Look out for the historic bridges and buildings along the way.
places.address: Carrera del Darro, 18010 Granada, Spain

places.name: Plaza Nueva
places.ai_summary: The oldest square in Granada, surrounded by historic buildings and vibrant with local life.

opening_hours.notes: A lively area with many bars and restaurants.

places.place_tip: Enjoy tapas in one of the many bars around the square.
places.address: Plaza Nueva, 18001 Granada, Spain

places.name: Monastery of Cartuja
places.ai_summary: A stunning example of Spanish Baroque architecture, this monastery is known for its ornate interior and peaceful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Take time to explore the beautiful gardens.
places.address: Camino de la Cartuja, s/n, 18012 Granada, Spain

places.ai_summary: A baroque basilica known for its stunning interior, dedicated to Saint John of God, the patron saint of Granada.
places.name_english: Basilica of San Juan de Dios
places.cost: Free entry, fees for guided tours

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to fully appreciate the basilica's art and architecture.
places.address: Calle San Juan de Dios, 23, 18001 Granada, Spain

places.ai_summary: A beautiful garden located in the Alhambra complex, offering a peaceful retreat and stunning views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in spring for blooming flowers.

places.place_tip: Explore the various themed gardens and enjoy the views from the terrace.
places.address: Carmen de los Mártires, s/n, 18009 Granada, Spain

places.ai_summary: An interactive science museum with exhibits on various scientific topics, suitable for all ages.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for special workshops and planetarium shows.
places.address: Avenida de la Ciencia, s/n, 18006 Granada, Spain

places.name: Triunfo Gardens
places.ai_summary: A public park in Granada, perfect for a leisurely stroll or a picnic, with beautiful views of the Alhambra.

opening_hours.notes: Gates close at 21:00, but the park remains accessible.

places.place_tip: Bring a book or a picnic and enjoy the peaceful surroundings.
places.address: Paseo del Triunfo, s/n, 18010 Granada, Spain

places.name: Realejo Quarter
places.ai_summary: The old Jewish quarter of Granada, full of narrow streets, historic buildings, and a vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the area on foot to fully appreciate its history.

places.place_tip: Visit the Plaza de San Nicolás for a great view of the Alhambra.
places.address: Realejo, 18001 Granada, Spain

places.ai_summary: A historic path with stunning views of the Alhambra, leading down to the Darro River.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning views.

places.ai_summary: A scenic promenade along the Darro River, popular for its picturesque views and historic significance.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed on foot. Be cautious of uneven surfaces.

places.place_tip: Look out for the historic buildings and bridges along the way.

places.ai_summary: A traditional Arab bathhouse offering a unique and relaxing experience in the heart of Granada.

places.place_tip: Try to book a private room for a more intimate experience.

places.ai_summary: A famous street in Granada known for its vibrant tapas bars and lively atmosphere.
places.cost: Free to explore, cost of tapas varies

opening_hours.notes: Lively atmosphere, especially in the evenings.

places.place_tip: Try the local specialty, 'tortilla del Sacromonte', in one of the tapas bars.

places.ai_summary: A popular day trip from Granada, offering stunning mountain scenery and outdoor activities.

places.place_tip: Check the weather forecast and dress accordingly.
